about: The `pages_read` table, published whole. See /api/schema for its grain. This file is part 54 of 55 for fy 2019.

rows.proof: `TOWN OF LUNENBURG / FY2019 COLLECTION OF TAXES / RECEIVABLES SUMMARY / JUNE 30, 2019`, PDF page 55 of the FY2019 annual town report (PRINTED FOLIO 53 -- the folio runs two behind the PDF page throughout this report). READ, NOT RECOGNISED where it mattered: pdfplumber returns 0 words on this page, so there is no text layer; the page is a single JPEG2000 bitmap of 1275x1651 px (~150 dpi) with the table printed SIDEWAYS. EIGHT COLUMNS, NAMED FROM THE PRINTED HEADER, verbatim: FORWARD | COMMITTMENTS [sic] | ABATEMENTS | PAYMENTS | REFUNDS | TRANSFER | ADJUSTMENTS | BALANCES. 24 ROWS CLOSE INDEPENDENTLY TO THE CENT on forward + commitments + abatements + payments + refunds + transfer + adjustments = balances; the page prints its negatives in PARENTHESES per column, so the identity is a signed SUM and not a subtraction. Measured page rotation +0.00728, measured row pitch 0.01415, band half of that (rule 13b). THE REFUSAL REASON ON RECORD IS FALSE: `receivables-refused.csv` says of FY2019 pages 53, 54 and 55 `no BALANCES column printed, so no row can be proved`. BALANCES IS PRINTED -- it is the eighth column of the printed header and it is reproduced here; the whole header band sits inside the top 22.7% of the page that the COMMITTED clipped OCR render discarded, so the extractor could not see the column it then reported as absent (rule 13c, a statement about our instrument published as a statement about the town). ROW KEYS ARE QUALIFIED BY THEIR PRINTED SECTION because a label is not a key: this page prints `LEVY OF 2007` through `LEVY OF 2018` under TWO different section headings, and keying on the label alone would collapse 24 rows into 12 and let the file pass with reduced power. `GRAND TOTAL` on this page is the total of the WHOLE RUN (pages 53-55). It closes on the row identity like every other row, which proves the row internally; it is NOT footed here against the 85 detail rows of the three pages, and no page-level subtotal is printed to foot any page on its own.  WHAT THIS DOES NOT ESTABLISH: the run's GRAND TOTAL is printed on page 55 and is the total of the WHOLE run (53-55); it is not footed here against the three pages' rows, and no page-level subtotal is printed to foot each page on its own.

rows.proof: THE FY 2020 OMNIBUS BUDGET, pages 161-164 of the FY2019 annual town report (printed pages 159-162) -- 92 numbered line items (1 to 82, with letter suffixes, no gap in the numbering), 6 nested subtotals and 12 section totals under a printed `Total Omnibus $38,058,164.30`. THE PRINTED HEADER, VERBATIM: the table is titled `FY 2020 Omnibus Budget`, its left column is headed `Line / No.` and its single money column is headed `FY20 / Town Manager` -- that heading is printed on pp.162 only; pp.161, 163 and 164 print the `Line / No.` stub with the money column's heading cell BLANK. The column is named here from the heading that IS printed, never inferred. ALL FOUR PAGES ARE PHOTOGRAPHS: pdfplumber returns 0 words for each, each carries one JBIG2Decode image at 4400x3400 (400 dpi) with /Rotate 270. pdfminer cannot decode JBIG2, so each page was rendered upright at native resolution with pypdfium2 and read. No recognition was used; the committed OCR TSV lost the top of pp.161, 162 and 164 and is not a starting point. WHAT PROVES IT: TWO GRAINS OF THE SAME TABLE CHECKED AGAINST THE SAME PRINTED Total Omnibus. (1) `section_total` -- the TWELVE section totals (Maturing Debt, Gen Gov Unclassified, General Government, Central Purchasing, Protection, Health & Sanitation, DPW, Facilities & Buildings, Solid Waste/Recycling, Assistance, Schools, Library) sum to $38,058,164.30, EXACTLY the printed Total Omnibus. (2) `voted` -- the 92 line items sum to $38,600,831.30, which is $542,667.00 OVER, and that residual is ATTESTED rather than tolerated because it is wholly and exactly accounted for by two places where THE TOWN'S OWN PRINTED FIGURES DISAGREE WITH EACH OTHER. SIXTEEN of the eighteen printed group totals foot their own line items TO THE CENT, Total Protection foots its four subtotals exactly and Total Assistance foots its two exactly. THE TWO THAT DO NOT. (a) p162 prints `38 Central Purchasing $ 603,030.00` and, three rows beneath it, `Total Central Purchasing $ 60,303.00` -- a factor of ten apart, $542,727.00. Both were read at 400 dpi off the page's own bitmap and both are as printed. The grand total is footed on the $60,303.00 version. WHICH OF THE TWO THE TOWN MEANT IS NOT ESTABLISHED HERE. (b) p162 prints `43 Fire Department $1,093,374.24`, `43A Capital - Fire Dept. $20,000.00`, `44 Fire Hydrant Expense $15,000.00` and `45 Radio Equipment Mtc. $10,000.00`, footing to $1,138,374.24, and then `Subtotal Fire Dept. $1,138,434.24` -- $60.00 more than its own four lines. Total Protection $3,462,434.21 is footed on the $1,138,434.24 version. 542,727.00 - 60.00 = 542,667.00, which is the whole of the `voted` residual: no other misread could leave it at exactly that figure without also breaking one of the sixteen sections that foot. NEITHER IS A TOLERANCE and neither is OUR reading failing -- both are named here and in table-corrections.csv. EXPLICIT NIL: 11 lines print `$   -` and are recorded as 0.00, which is what the sections they sit in require: 3B Bond Issuance Costs, 12A Agricultural Commission, 14A Unemployment Expense - Stab Fund, 18 Charter Review Committee, 20 Selectmen Salaries, 27 Assessor's Salaries, 49 Wiring Inspector, 51 Municipal Hearing Officer, 52 Plumbing/Gas Inspector, 57 Mental Health, 61A Capital - General Highway, 72A Additional Utilities, Library, 79A Unemployment School - Stab/Free Cash, 81 Vehicle Mtc - School. WHAT THIS IS AND IS NOT: this is the budget the Town Manager put FORWARD for FY20 as it is printed in the FY2019 annual report. It is not FY2019 spending, and it is a proposal rather than an appropriation -- the appropriations schedule on pp.32-36 of the same report is the different quantity.

The town's own grand total is footed on $60,303.00 and on $1,138,434.24: the twelve section totals sum to $38,058,164.30 to the cent. WHICH FIGURE THE TOWN MEANT IN EITHER CASE IS NOT ESTABLISHED, and nothing in the document says.

rows.reconciliation: 6 full pages carry 94 rows, the last carries 35; surname runs in order through all 599 rows
rows.read_by: claude-opus-5 reading the page bitmap stored IN the PDF (pypdfium2 PdfImage.get_bitmap(render=False) -> PIL, no renderer; the stream is JBIG2 and pdfplumber's get_data() hands back the undecoded codestream), rotated upright by the page's own /Rotate 270, panel crops at 1:1
rows.proof: COVERAGE, not arithmetic: `2019 CALENDAR YEAR WAGES`, PDF pages 197-203 of the FY2019 annual town report (printed folios 195-201), prints NO TOTAL anywhere -- no page total, no grand total, no subtotal -- so nothing here can be footed and A MISREAD DIGIT WOULD SURVIVE EVERY ASSERTION IN THIS FILE UNTOUCHED. 599 names are printed across the seven pages: 94 on each of pages 197-202 and 35 on page 203. THE PAGE IS ONE TABLE OF SEVEN COLUMNS, NOT TWO TABLES -- surname, first name, amount, a narrow EMPTY ruled column, then surname, first name, amount again -- and the two halves are ONE CONTINUOUS A-Z SEQUENCE, read down the LEFT three columns of a page and then down the RIGHT three: ABARE-BIENVENU, BIERY-CAMPBELL, CANTATORE-CORRIGAN, COTE-FAIOLA, FARRAR-GRIGAS, GROTE-KLAFT, KLINGAMAN-MACDOUGALL, MACKINNON-MCGUIGAN, MCGUIRE-NYGREN, OKERMAN-RENZI, RHODES-SHORT, SICARD-TSIAKALOS, TYLER-ZRATE. Every one of the twelve panel boundaries carries on alphabetically, which is the evidence for reading it as one list rather than as the two independent A-Z lists FY2020 and FY2022 print; those years are transcribed as `-column-a`/`-column-b` for that reason and this year is not. Each page opens with one centred title `2019 CALENDAR YEAR WAGES` ABOVE the ruled box, with white space between: there is NO column header row and NO row hidden under the header -- settled by stacking the title band and the first two rows of all seven pages into one image and reading it, not inferred. Pages 196 and 204 were walked too: 196 is the election result and vital records page and 204 is BLANK but for its folio, so the run neither starts earlier nor ends later. Every page is a PHOTOGRAPH (0 words of text layer on all 206 pages of this report) carrying ONE embedded JBIG2 bitmap at 4400x3400, 400 dpi -- the best resolution in this archive -- and was read from the stored bitmap rather than from a render, so no canvas could be sized for one geometry and drawn with another. WHAT IS ASSERTED IS THE SHAPE: 94 rows on every page but the last, exactly one money figure per row (599 of 599 rows parse as one amount with cents), and the surname sequence never going backwards -- 0 backward steps in 599 rows, on the TOWN'S OWN SORT, where a space sorts before a letter so `ST JEAN` precedes `STADLER`. A SECOND INSTRUMENT WAS RUN AGAINST THE SAME SEVEN PAGES: the recognition reading in `gross-wages.csv` holds 516 rows for them, and ALL 516 are accounted for by this reading -- 509 matched by name and 7 more by amount alone because recognition mangled the name (BERRYR CATHLEEN, BETTI LINDAR, BLANCHETTE LERIN, BUTEAU WEIGOLOJOYCE, DANCE IROBIN, DUSEK JAYNER, MCKENZIER LAURA). 516 of 516 amounts agree to THE CENT: 516 agreements, 0 disagreements. The 83 rows this reading holds that recognition does not are whole names it dropped, 65 of them on page 200 alone, which is why that page shows 29 rows there and 94 here. `report-gross-wages.csv` holds only 42 rows for this run, all on page 199, and nothing for the other six pages. ROW ALIGNMENT BETWEEN THE TWO HALVES IS CHECKED INDEPENDENTLY of the transcription, because an off-by-one between the halves is the error a two-panel page makes most easily: the column rules print solid on page 197 and were measured there as fractions of the table's own width (0, .235, .394, .506, .554, .719, .887, 1), the row grid was laid on each page as a uniform pitch between that page's measured table top and bottom, and the ink in every cell was counted. On pages 197-202 all 282 row bands carry ink in all SIX content columns -- 1,692 of 1,692 cells occupied, 0 rows short -- so the left name and the right amount of a row are the same printed row. The narrow fourth column is empty on page 197, the page whose rules print cleanly. That rules out an off-by-one in either half; IT SAYS NOTHING ABOUT ANY INDIVIDUAL DIGIT. PAGE 203 PRINTS 35 NAMES IN ITS LEFT HALF AND AN EMPTY RULED GRID OF 35 ROWS IN ITS RIGHT -- the page prints the grid and no names in it, read at full resolution, exactly as FY2021's last wage page does. Five names are printed TRUNCATED by their own column rule and are recorded as printed: p197 `BUTEAU WEIGOLD`, p198 `DIAMANTOPOULC`, p200 `MARTINEZ-NIEME` and `MCCARTHY-GUILL`, p201 `PETERSON-BLANK` (FY2020 prints the same person as `PETERSON-BLANKENSI` and FY2021 as `PETERSON-BLANKEN`) and `PUNALES-SANTIAG`. RESIDUAL, stated rather than hidden: `gross-wages.csv` and `report-gross-wages.csv` still hold their own recognition of these same seven pages, so three readings of one quantity live in the archive until `extract_gross_wages.py` discards its reading of any page `page-reads` holds.
